---
title: "With Nordic-RSE we have an association dedicated to the community of Research Software Engineers in the Nordics. What tasks do you think should be undertaken by Nordic-RSE or a future Nordic institute for research software?"
question_id: org4nord
---

```{r}
#| include: false
#| file: ../R/_load_common.R
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
question_code <- "org4nord"

nordic_countries <- c(
  "Finland", "Norway", "Sweden", "Denmark", "Iceland", "Estonia"
)
country_groups <- list(
  Nordics = nordic_countries,
  Germany = "Germany",
  Netherlands = "Netherlands"
)
plot_countries <- countries_from_groups(country_groups)
```

### Free-text responses

```{r}
#| echo: false
source(file.path(book_root, "R/recodes/org4nord_recode.R"))

cleaned_data <- process_text_codes_with_allocation(
  filter = FILTER,
  question_code = "org4nord",
  recode_map = org4nord_recode_map, 
  header = "Nordic RSE - Tasks",
  other = TRUE,
  cache_id = "org4nord"
)

cleaned_data$summary_table
```

The raw-to-category allocation table for this question is in @sec-appendix-recoding.
